📤 Bulk Upload Meta Leads

Export your leads from Meta Ads Manager as a CSV, then upload it here. Country is detected automatically from each phone number (+91 → India, +44 → UK, +92 → Pakistan, +880 → Bangladesh) — you'll get a chance to review before anything is saved. Campaign, ad set, ad name, email, and city are all picked up automatically if your export includes those columns — make sure "email" and "city" are included as column headers in your export so they show up here.
